name: Genaya Connect
description: Hosted MCP server for Genaya, an operations app for service businesses: ask about appointments, clients, invoices, calls and tasks, and prepare changes that run only after the member confirms them. Streamable HTTP at https://api.genaya.com/mcp with Genaya account OAuth 2.1. Commercial hosted product; there is no free plan, every plan starts with a 14-day free trial.
